t: Rodkin, A. Z. - Chairman Of Polish Aid Society

pages.en:
Aid Society
-2-
The distribution of the money is under
constant control of the I.R.C., because the persons
supported have to sign receipts, which are handed to
the I.R.C.
The number of refugees registered with
the Society is 931, but at present only 788 are in need
of support. Apart from the monetary support, the Society
has an arrangement with the "Altmann's Restaurant" at
752 Avenue Joffre, according to which the restaurant
issues 240 tiffins daily at a reduced rate to Polish
refugees. The difference between the reduced rate and
the actual cost is born by the Society.
The office of the Society is located at
41 Route Cohen, Tel.73004. Its chairman is Mr.A.Z.Rod-
kin, Shanghai resident since 14 years, who resides at
374/Apt.35 Kingse Rd.,Tel.12662. He is the owner of
a textile manufacturing firm "Paros" which has its
office at 109 Rte Vallon.
At the time of formation of the Society,
the Japanese Authorities and the French Police were in-
formed accordingly. No registration has as yet been made
with the S.M.Police. In view of the fact that most of
the Society's dependents will soon live in the Interna-
tional Settlement(designated area), it is respectfully
suggested, that the chairman be instructed to register
the Society with this Section.
D.n S.
O i/c Foreign Affairs Section
C & S Branch

援助协会
-2-
款项的发放处于国际救济委员会（I.R.C.）的持续监管之下，因为受助人员必须签署收据，并将收据提交给国际救济委员会。
在该协会登记的难民人数为931人，但目前仅有788人需要资助。除金钱资助外，该协会还与位于霞飞路752号的“阿尔特曼餐厅”（Altmann's Restaurant）达成安排，根据该安排，餐厅每日以优惠价格向波兰难民提供240份午餐便当。优惠价格与实际成本之间的差额由该协会承担。
该协会的办事处位于科恩路41号，电话73004。其主席为A.Z.罗德金（A.Z. Rodkin）先生，他已在上海居住14年，现居金神路（Kingse Rd.）374号35室，电话12662。他是纺织制造企业“帕罗斯”（Paros）的所有人，该公司办事处位于瓦隆路109号。
在该协会成立时，已相应通知日本当局和法国警察。但尚未向上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.Police）进行登记。鉴于该协会大多数受抚养人不久将居住于国际公共租界（指定区域），谨建议指示主席向本处登记该协会。
D.n S.
外事股股长
刑事与特别股
